hulls.label: Full Bulbous
hulls.description: High block coefficient, squared transom, bulbous bow — tankers and bulk carriers

hulls.label: Fine Bulbous
hulls.description: Low block coefficient, raking bow, pronounced bulb — container ships and cruise

hulls.label: Plumb Bow
hulls.description: Vertical stem, spoon stern, fuel-efficient — modern cargo and container

hulls.label: Ro-Ro / Ferry
hulls.description: High freeboard, flush sides, ramp stern — car carriers and Ro-Ro ferries

superstructures.label: Aft Block
superstructures.description: Tall rectangular block at aft — standard on tankers and bulk carriers

superstructures.label: Aft Tiered
superstructures.description: Stepped/tiered superstructure — modern tankers and product carriers

superstructures.label: Aft Narrow
superstructures.description: Narrow streamlined tower — container ships and modern cargo

superstructures.label: Mid Block
superstructures.description: Block superstructure at midship — general cargo and reefers

superstructures.label: Fwd Block
superstructures.description: Forward-positioned superstructure — bulk carriers with forward placement

superstructures.label: Fwd Integrated
superstructures.description: Flush integrated forward superstructure — Ro-Ro, car carriers, passenger

superstructures.label: Split Aft
superstructures.description: Separated bridge and funnel structure — general cargo with gantry

superstructures.label: Cruise Tiered
superstructures.description: Multi-deck tiered accommodation — cruise ships and large ferries

funnels.label: Round Tall
funnels.description: Standard tall round funnel — general cargo and tankers

funnels.label: Round Squat
funnels.description: Short wide funnel — VLCCs and large tankers

funnels.label: Flared
funnels.description: Flared top with uptake — product tankers and chemical carriers

funnels.label: Twin Funnels
funnels.description: Twin side-by-side funnels — ferries and older liners

funnels.label: Cowl Top
funnels.description: Cowl-capped funnel — cruise ships and modern passenger vessels

funnels.label: Suppressed
funnels.description: Very low exhaust uptake integrated into superstructure — modern eco designs

cargos.label: Containers (High)
cargos.description: Tall container stacks — post-Panamax and ultra-large container ships

cargos.label: Containers (Low)
cargos.description: Shallow container stacks — feeder vessels and panamax

cargos.label: Bulk Hatches
cargos.description: Flush hatch covers — standard bulk carriers

cargos.label: Open Hatch
cargos.description: Open cargo holds — timber, pulp, and open-hatch bulkers

cargos.label: Crude Deck
cargos.description: Crude tanker main deck with manifold and pipe runs

cargos.label: Product Deck
cargos.description: Clean/product tanker — manifold centreline, minimal pipework

cargos.label: LNG Spheres
cargos.description: Moss-type spherical LNG tanks rising above deck

cargos.label: LNG Membrane
cargos.description: Membrane-type LNG — flush prismatic tanks, low deck profile

cargos.label: Ro-Ro Decks
cargos.description: Multi-level vehicle decks visible at stern — car carriers and Ro-Ro

cargos.label: Ship's Cranes
cargos.description: Deck cranes/gear — geared bulk, general cargo, multipurpose
